authoring_rules: Use a fresh LLM translator per locale, not either of that locale's independent auditors. Record actual served model or explicitly qualified unknown provenance, never infer serving identity from a resumed header.

Human Choice.label and other headings/help must be translated separately from stable Choice.value. Keep all serialized values, commands, flags, config names, protocol tokens and executable examples byte-identical.

Accept the union of concrete meaning defects: characters versus lines, exclusions versus deletion, comma separation versus tasks, screening calls per hour versus fractions of an hour, standard vocal delivery versus constant value or price.

Preserve genuine proper product/provider/model names, identifiers, code and protocol names. A named default agent is distinct from a generic role or feature noun. Librarian, Library, Hub, ANSWER and similar words are not blanket brand exemptions.

For glossary-kept borrowed technical terms, cite the exact per-locale glossary entry AND the individual key's technical usage. Translate surrounding ordinary prose. A glossary does not justify raw true/false/default/manual/female/provider labels or untranslated whole sentences.

If a proposed major fix would rename an actual identifier or contradict a scoped technical glossary, report the key, consumer/context/glossary proof and rejection to Root; do not silently skip it or change a machine value.

Fold minor semantic/idiom issues into the same wave only when directly adjacent to accepted major copy and not a new scope. Width flags are static risks, not observed clipping; measure/render at integration and shorten if actually needed. No minor-only wave.

Do not change any unrelated locale or English/context after the English checkpoint. Do not hand-edit generated keys, eligibility, history snapshots or ratchet baselines. No self-audit, native/browser runs, dependency installs or new worktrees by translators.

Follow with independent A/B delta audits of changed keys and direct reference neighbors; explicitly bind byte/source-compatible unchanged per-key semantic records from the completed 895-pair audits. Never fabricate a zero-key pass as proof for the rest of the namespace.
